mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.reject_no, r.inspect_id, r.inspect_no, r.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, u.name AS unit, r.qty, r.decision, r.dispose_remark, r.approver, r.create_time FROM qc_reject r LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = r.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS inspectId, i.inspect_no AS inspectNo, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, i.unqualified_qty AS unqualifiedQty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.qty) FROM qc_reject r WHERE r.inspect_id = i.id AND r.deleted = 0), 0) AS disposedQty, i.unqualified_qty - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.qty) FROM qc_reject r WHERE r.inspect_id = i.id AND r.deleted = 0), 0) AS rejectableQty FROM qc_inspect i LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = i.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE i.status = 10 AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.unqualified_qty > 0 HAVING rejectableQty > 0 ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 200
